dataset_source: Pima Indians Diabetes Database (National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases)
split_strategy: Stratified 80/20 hold-out; model chosen only on the 80% dev partition via CV.

cleaning.zero_as_missing_rationale: A glucose / diastolic BP / triceps skin fold / serum insulin / BMI of exactly 0 is physiologically impossible in a living adult and is the Pima dataset's missing-value placeholder. pregnancies == 0 (nulliparous) and age are genuine values and are left untouched.
cleaning.missing_value_handling: ZeroToNaN runs first *inside* the pipeline, then SimpleImputer(median) fills the NaNs using training-fold medians only. Nothing is imputed from validation or holdout rows.
cleaning.duplicate_policy: Exact duplicate rows removed before splitting (Pima has no patient id; 0 found).

missing_value_policy: ZeroToNaN runs first *inside* the pipeline, then SimpleImputer(median) fills the NaNs using training-fold medians only. Nothing is imputed from validation or holdout rows.
preprocessing: Pipeline: ZeroToNaN(glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin, bmi) -> ColumnTransformer(numeric -> SimpleImputer(median) + StandardScaler) -> estimator. All learned statistics are fit on training folds only.
imbalance_handling: Pima is ~35% positive. class_weight (None vs 'balanced') is a tuned hyper-parameter chosen by CV per family. Operating threshold left at 0.5; a dev-only precision/recall/Youden sweep is published but not used for tuning. No SMOTE (see model metrics feature_engineering / notes).

feature_engineering.decision: Engineered interaction terms REJECTED: mean DEV CV ROC-AUC change -0.0046 (< 0.005 required).

hyperparameter_search: GridSearchCV over StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, seed) per family, scoring=roc_auc.

model_selection.rule: max DEV CV ROC-AUC, then simplest family within 0.01 ROC-AUC of the best

limitations: All subjects are Pima women aged 21+ near Phoenix, Arizona; the model is not a general-population screen and will not transfer to men, children, or other ancestries.
Roughly half the insulin and a third of the skin-fold values were missing (encoded as 0) and are median-imputed; predictions for such records lean on the remaining features.
Permutation importance describes model behaviour on this sample, not physiological causation.
disclaimer: Educational and research use only. This estimates a risk pattern learned from a public dataset and is not a medical diagnosis.
